subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Navy : Ship :: Army : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

The Navy of a country operates in SEA. Therefore, a Ship is the main component of a NAVY.

Similarly, 

The Army of a country operates on LAND. Therefore, the Tank is the main component of an ARMY.

Hence, 'Tank' is the correct answer.

• Arjun is an indigenous main battle tank of the Indian army.
 
• The Arjun Main Battle Tank project was initiated by DRDO in 1972 with the Combat Vehicles Research and Development Establishment (CVRDE) as its lead laboratory.
 
• Mass production began in 1996 at the Indian Ordnance Factory’s production facility in Avadi, Tamil Nadu.
